preconditions.description: The number of water tanks is between 2 and 50, inclusive.
The maximum increase in total width of pipes is between 0 and 1000, inclusive.
The width of each pipe is a non-negative integer, and the diagonal elements are zero.

preconditions.expression: cij = 0 if there is no pipe from tank i to tank j
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix represents the existence and width of pipes.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum amount of water that can be transmitted from the main tank to the sewer tank per unit of time.

postconditions.expression: output <= sum(cij for all i, j where i != j)
postconditions.description: The output does not exceed the sum of all possible pipe widths without any increase.

postconditions.expression: exists subset of pipes with total width increase <= k
postconditions.description: There exists a subset of pipes that can be increased in width by at most k units, such that the sum of the new widths is maximized.
